title: A股小市值策略：样本内选组与样本外验证

config.universe: historical Shanghai/Shenzhen mainboard, including former SME; exclude financials using contemporaneous evidence, CDR and listing age <252 sessions
config.return_convention: prior-close planned adjusted share orders, opening fills subject to opening suspension and limit eligibility; only prior cash may fund buys, sale proceeds fund orders from next session; month-end net NAV
limitations: Daily-bar fills without queue, capacity or intraday matching
Actual next-session daily replacement is not an intraday immediate replacement
Historical point-in-time snapshots may contain vendor revisions
Early suspended-stock capitalization estimates affect ranks
No causal identification of shell value
Historical 2024-2025 holdout inspected before final rules

repair_policy.unresolved_terminal_policy: documented delisting-date zero valuation; 50/100 percent last-quote sensitivities

config.validation_disclosure: 2024-2025 historical holdout already inspected before final protocol update
config.st_policy: Known-risk exclusion at monthly close; risk holdings submit exit orders at first subsequent open, sell proceeds fund preplanned forward replacement from the next session. Monthly rank list stays frozen.
config.delisting_trading_policy: Names containing 退 identify publicly known delisting trading, never ordinary non-ST eligibility
config.replacement_policy: Prior-close candidate choice and fixed adjusted share quantity, funded only by prior available cash. No same-open reaction to another fill. Failed orders retry or advance only at the following planning close. Strategies independently use the monthly frozen rank list.
config.buy_budget_policy: Each order reserves quantity times the pre-open published upper-limit price plus cost; total reserved cash cannot exceed prior-close cash. Auction price savings are reused only at the next planning date.
config.historical_industry_policy: Contemporaneous backup industry (same day or <=1 prior session), then already-published CSRC quarterly classification; no SW retrospective membership or future report-end company-type fallback.
config.input_gate_policy: Preserve raw coverage gaps; require complete financial/capitalization inputs for observable nonrisk signal candidates. Stocks excluded by risk status already known on signal date cannot affect filtered rank.

protocol.other_test_bands_role: descriptive comparisons; never replace the training winner

selection_validation.interpretation: 样本内按30bp成本后夏普从五档中选出1—100组并冻结；其样本外收益排名第1，夏普排名第2。其余四档只作描述性对照，不按样本外表现换组。
selection_validation.disclosure: 2024—2025为样本外（历史留出）；结果在研究过程中已查看，不宣称未窥视或完全独立验证。

repairs.title: 按执行时点解释停牌
repairs.problem: 下午暂停曾阻挡上午开盘卖出。
repairs.fix: 区分开盘暂停与日内暂停，使用suspend_timing，不用下午事件阻止上午订单。
repairs.limit: 上午暂停后的日线open可能是复牌首价，不能一概视为开盘集合竞价。

repairs.title: 行业按历史证据生效
repairs.problem: SW回溯分类曾决定早期金融剔除。
repairs.fix: 优先当时快照；早期使用已发布证监会分类，按可得日推进。
repairs.evidence: 000617重组前后的行业资格需按实际日期变化。
repairs.limit: 季度公开分类并非逐日业务变更数据库。

repairs.title: 补齐历史风险状态证据
repairs.problem: namechange缺区间导致普通股票被排为未知。
repairs.fix: 合并历史简称快照与公开证据，保留来源、可得日和冲突记录；不以当前简称回填。
repairs.evidence: 标准股份、金鹰股份、粤宏远A、民丰特纸。
repairs.limit: 仍无法确认的股票明确未知并披露过滤前覆盖。

repairs.title: 成交确认后跨日补仓
repairs.problem: 实际卖出所得曾用于同一开盘价补仓。
repairs.fix: 前收盘固定股数计划，旧现金才能资助当日买单；卖款最早下一交易日补仓。
repairs.evidence: 交易账本保存plan_date、funding_asof及执行日。
repairs.limit: 当天成交后立即补仓需分钟数据，本版不伪装为盘中立即。

conclusions: 2015—2023样本内，五档均参与单边30bp成本后夏普选优；1—100组以夏普0.88胜出，年化22.99%，随后冻结。
冻结赢家在2024—2025样本外年化23.42%，夏普0.78，日度最大回撤-45.16%；收益排名第1，夏普排名第2。
样本外年化收益最高为1—100组，夏普最高为401—500组；最小组的收益领先点估计延续，但风险调整后领先未延续，不能据此认定市值越小越好。
冻结赢家相对中证1000价格指数月均收益差0.86%，HAC(6)95%区间[-1.45%, 3.18%]；指数年化13.58%。
最小组样本外：仅月初过滤年化23.67%，增加风险退出留现金23.35%，再加次日补仓23.42%；该期间退出补仓收益未高于仅过滤。
2024—2025为样本外（历史留出）；结果在研究过程中已查看，不宣称未窥视或完全独立验证。
成本、终值及ST规则对照均覆盖五档，不据此更换训练赢家；规则对照为解释实验。
月度排名固定；受阻交易、跨日资金和现金导致实际持仓并非始终100只等权。
本研究尚未识别壳价值因果效应，也没有验证资金容量或真实盘中即时补仓。
limitations: 股票复权收益与中证1000价格指数存在分红口径差异；指数没有ETF实施费用。
日线开盘成交是近似，不含队列、成交量容量与冲击成本；买单为前一收盘计划，卖出回款下一交易日才可用于买入。
早期停牌市值仍含最后可观察值估计，历史财报版本未逐条认证。
历史分类按证据可得日期使用；季度分类存在公开发布滞后和分类体系切换。
ST未知状态仍限制买入；来源冲突和未解决覆盖必须单列，不能将过滤后未知占比为零解释为全池无缺口。
